physicalNotes: Radius 0.05709707 Jupiter radii from Adams et al. 2021 (2021PSJ.....2..152A), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021PSJ.....2..152A/abstract): 4,082 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Smith et al. 2018 (2018MNRAS.474.5523S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018MNRAS.474.5523S/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.5 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
